title: Beck Anxiety Inventory
description: 21 anxiety symptoms over the past month, each rated 0–3.

citation.text: Beck AT, Epstein N, Brown G, Steer RA (1988). An inventory for measuring clinical anxiety: psychometric properties. Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology 56(6):893–897.

scoring.text: Sum of the 21 items (0–63): 0–7 minimal, 8–15 mild, 16–25 moderate, 26–63 severe. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
